messages.campaign_fixture.quest.spawns.title: Campaign fixture: dedicated mentor
messages.campaign_fixture.quest.spawns.descriptio: Meet a mentor created for this campaign. Every player shares this persistent character.
campaign_fixture.quest.spawns.offer.line: This campaign creates one mentor near its saved village. Returning or reloading keeps the same character and their belongings.
campaign_fixture.quest.spawns.reminder.l: Reach the village marked by this quest. The mentor needs safe ground nearby and will never remove blocks to make room.
campaign_fixture.quest.spawns.report.lin: You returned to the same mentor. Another villager cannot finish this test, even when ordinary quests allow compatible providers.
